questions.def: Extraposition uses 'it' to move the real subject to the end.
questions.question: ___ important to eat healthy food.

questions.def: We use 'it' as a dummy subject in extraposition.
questions.question: ___ difficult to learn a new language.

questions.def: The verb 'seem' agrees with the dummy subject 'it'.
questions.question: ___ that he likes her.

questions.def: 'It's' is a contraction of 'it is', used in extraposition.
questions.question: ___ nice to meet you.

questions.def: Extraposition structure: It + be + adjective + to infinitive.
questions.question: ___ necessary to finish the work today.

questions.def: 'It is' is the correct extraposition structure here.
questions.question: ___ good to see you again.

questions.def: Passive extraposition: It + is/was + past participle + that clause.
questions.question: ___ believed that he was innocent.

questions.def: 'It is said' introduces a generally accepted idea.
questions.question: ___ said that the meeting is cancelled.

questions.def: Passive extraposition with 'expect': It is expected that...
questions.question: ___ that she will win.

questions.def: 'It's' (it is) expresses an opinion or feeling.
questions.question: ___ a pity you can't come.

questions.def: 'It's obvious' is a common extraposition phrase.
questions.question: ___ obvious that they are happy.

questions.def: 'It seems' is a common way to express an impression.
questions.question: ___ that he is tired.

questions.def: It + be + adjective + to infinitive (extraposition).
questions.question: ___ good to exercise regularly.

questions.def: 'It's nice of you...' expresses gratitude.
questions.question: ___ nice of you to help me.

questions.def: Passive extraposition: It is believed that...
questions.question: ___ that she is honest.

questions.def: It's is a contraction for 'it is'.
questions.question: ___ important to call him back.

questions.def: It's used to talk about the weather.
questions.question: ___ likely to rain tomorrow.

questions.def: Passive extraposition: It is thought that...
questions.question: ___ that he will come.

questions.def: It + be + adjective + to infinitive.
questions.question: ___ necessary to have a visa.

questions.def: 'It's good to see you' is a common phrase.
questions.question: ___ good to see you again.

questions.def: Passive extraposition: It is known that...
questions.question: ___ that she is a good doctor.

questions.def: It's is a contraction for 'it is'.
questions.question: ___ hard to understand him.

questions.def: 'It's a pleasure' is a common phrase.
questions.question: ___ a pleasure to meet you.

questions.def: Extraposition uses 'it' to move the real subject after the verb.
questions.question: ___ important to eat healthy food.

questions.def: We use 'it is' to start sentences with postponed subjects.
questions.question: ___ difficult to learn a new language.

questions.def: 'It is' should replace 'Is' for correct extraposition.
questions.question: Is important that you go now.

questions.def: Use 'It seems' to introduce an impersonal verb with a 'that' clause.
questions.question: ___ that he doesn't want to work.

questions.def: 'It's' is the correct shortened form of 'It is'.
questions.question: ___ good to see you again.

questions.def: 'It is' introduces the true subject after the verb.
questions.question: ___ necessary to finish the work today.

questions.def: The passive form 'It is believed' is used to express common opinion.
questions.question: ___ that she will win.
